Hero_Desc_Barong:
A phantom who goes around with a stuffed bunny.
She likes to pull pranks and cause trouble, making excuses that she is possessed by these incredible beings.
Where did she get the doll that's in her arms?
Album_Like_Barong: People hesitating on where to look when talking to her.
Album_Hate_Barong: Sympathy from people who pretend to believe her.
Album_Hobby_Barong: Trying to sew up a torn doll—always failing and making it look worse.
Album_Wish_Barong: Sometimes wishing that the illusions she spreads were real.
Album_Barong1: Barong, who carries around eerie dolls, is a phantom that other Apostles find difficult to approach. It's not necessarily because she's scary, but more because Barong hardly ever responds in conversation.
Album_Barong2: Whenever Barong encounters an Apostle, she calls their name and drives a nail into a voodoo doll. I told her it might make people uncomfortable and asked her to stop. In response, she simply called my name and stabbed the doll again.
Album_Barong3: Barong always keeps her eyes unfocused during conversations, making it hard to tell if she's really listening. But there's a trick to figuring it out: if even one of the many eyes on her dolls is looking at you, it means she's paying attention.
Album_Barong4: Barong is particularly prone to mumbling nonsensical phrases. At first, her jumbled sentences sound deep and meaningful, but upon closer thought, they mostly don't make sense at all.
Album_Barong5: Barong mentioned that she has three close phantom friends. Even without asking, I could guess who—it's bound to be the ones who play with masks, pumpkins, and cards.
Album_Barong6: I've seen Barong lingering around Chloe's Tailor Shop. She seems to have a habit of picking up the dolls Chloe discards as failures. Feeling a little sorry for her, I asked if she'd like a brand-new one. But Barong shook her head, saying that she only liked dolls that are worn and used.
Album_Barong7: As I got closer to Barong and had longer conversations with her, she confessed that her habit of avoiding eye contact started because she was too shy to look people in the eye. Now that she's used to it, she continues doing it out of habit. Other than her frequent nonsensical talk, she's not really a bad person... or phantom.
LoveHero_Barong: You're gonna play with me? Hehehe... I'll make it fun!
LoveHeroCancel_Barong: Humm... The Queen of Fun says she doesn't need you...!
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Hate1: She spat it out on the table, saying it tastes too bland without seasoning.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Hate2: She grumbled that there's no point in having healthy food in Elias, since everyone is already healthy.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like1: She said she loves the confusing mixture of sweetness and the kick that it adds.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like2: She found it fun that you can't tell if it's a gem or candy until you pop it in your mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like3: She said that it feels like a soft, fluffy doll. Does she chew dolls too?
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like4: She was impressed that the cake looks almost indistinguishable from a log.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like5: She liked how it tasted like lemon despite the gritty, sand-like texture.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like6: She made a fuss, saying the lord of Songpyeon only allows sesame seeds for the fillings. She stopped when I popped one in her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like7: She said that sugar is a good fuel for using her head. But I bet she only uses her head for mischief.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like8: She said she loves how folks scream when she sprinkles this on their eyes, pretending it's magical powder that puts them to sleep.
Food_ChefNote_Barong_Like9: She liked the taste of the candy that resembled phantoms. She even tried to feed it to her doll.

LoveLetter_Barong:
Hellooo, Master. I am Barong's friend, the rabbit doll.

Barong asked me to write this thing called a letter in her place, so consider yourself honored, all right? I heard you promised to visit a restaurant with Barong last time, so why has there been no word from you? Surely you did not say it without meaning it? Barong is waiting. Ah, keep that part a secret from Barong, all right?

Thank you for understanding our complicated relationship. Let us play together again next time. Hehehe.
LoveCall_Barong:
Ah, ah~
I am the one who can speak only through the telephone... Uh... the King of Telephones~
Hehehe, so hurry and tell me an entertaining story~
Or I shall place a truly terrifying curse upon you~

H-Huh? What kind of curse?
Hmm... Ah, I shall curse you so that you can never receive a call from anyone again...
I will personally sneak away with your phone and block every other number~
Hehe. Well? Frightening, is it not...?

What? Then you could not receive my calls either...?
I-I would simply block every number except mine!
So hurry up and give me an entertaining story.
The King of Fun... Ah, no. The King of Telephones is bored~ Hehe!
